#### Prerequisites:
- The PC has successfully installed the matching MDVRPlayer playback software, download address: [TTX latest installation package, manual download](http://faq.cmsv8.com/web/#/page/1156 "TTX latest installation package, manual download")
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=29f16f4f2dc145cdc2938913c18b2fa5)

- The PC has been connected to the SD card or hard disk taken out from the MDVR device, or there are video files copied on the computer

#### Operation steps:
###### Video playback
Here we take opening the MDVR SD card file as an example, the method of copying files to the computer is the same
1. Open the "MDVRPlayer" playback software
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=00e387edc6ad2aa63668f36f0752b7f1)

1. Play the video files in the folder, click "Select Folder" to open the SD card or hard disk video folder path, the folder name is "rec_file" confirm to open and scan and open all video files
ps: When opening the folder here, there will be a query and scan video file time, depending on the disk size and file proficiency. When the SD card or hard disk is hot-plugged from the device, the scanning time will also increase
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=5cc3b14de1cdd94bfd4ad7e6d52bd00f)
1. Select the time in the interface after scanning is completed, and click a window file to start playing
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=fd550281ceee780afff641a553a24541)
1. To play a single video file, click "Select File" to open the SD card or hard disk video folder path. The folder name is "rec_file". Open it again and select a video file ending with .cv1. Confirm to start playing.
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=ef86b0ec1d96f30c77c8f22977337882)
Play interface function introduction:
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=da9d55ccf04f6e8823c111743da648cd)
ps: When the video file system is stuck or the screen is stuck, please open the Windows Task Manager to check the CPU Is the memory resource occupied 100%? The more channels you play, the clearer the video quality, and the higher the decoding capability required of the PC hardware.

###### Convert video to MP4
Click the "MP4" button on the toolbar to pop up the conversion details interface, change some parameters and output path of the converted video as needed, click "Start conversion" and wait for the progress to complete 100%, open the converted video file path to view the converted MP4 file
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=642593c49724e124bbc5b37d454fd0fa)
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=8e05cf758f3584748bc0f95cb6e6aecb)
